definition_zh: 学费（按学期或学年收取的教学费用）
definition_en: the sum of money charged by a school or college for teaching, usually billed by term or by year
core_image: 餐桌上摊开的缴费通知单：一行是课时，一行是金额，旁边放着一台计算器
scene: 缴费通知单摊在餐桌上，旁边放着计算器和分期付款的说明，家长一行行核对数字，孩子站在门口不敢出声。The tuition fee for the program includes laboratory costs.
sceneCN: 这里指「学费」（第 1 个义项：学校按学期或学年收取的教学费用）；句意为该项目的学费包含实验室费用。图中可辨识物件：缴费通知单、计算器、分期说明、餐桌。

pos.zh: 学费（可数，指一笔按学期或学年计的费用）

senses.title: The annual charge for a degree
senses.titleCN: 按学年收取的学位学费
senses.definition: the yearly sum a college charges a student for instruction
senses.definitionCN: 学院每学年向学生收取的教学费用
senses.example: The tuition fee for the program includes laboratory costs.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目的学费包含实验室费用。
senses.why: the phrase makes explicit what the bare word leaves open: which charge, billed how often.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把单用词没说明的部分讲清：是哪一笔钱、按什么周期收。

senses.title: The charge for one course
senses.titleCN: 单门课程的学费
senses.definition: the amount billed for a particular course or module
senses.definitionCN: 为某门课程或模块计收的金额
senses.example: The tuition fee for the summer module is billed separately.
senses.exampleCN: 夏季模块的学费单独计收。
senses.why: billing splits one module from the rest, so the phrase narrows to a single line on the statement.
senses.whyCN: 计费把一门模块从其余部分拆开，短语就收窄为账单上的一行。

senses.title: The higher charge for overseas students
senses.titleCN: 国际学生的差额学费
senses.definition: the larger sum charged to students from outside the home country
senses.definitionCN: 向来自境外的学生收取的更高费用
senses.example: Overseas students pay a tuition fee nearly twice the local rate.
senses.exampleCN: 国际学生缴的学费接近本地标准的两倍。
senses.why: a different payer is charged a different rate, so the phrase carries the student's identity as well as the sum.
senses.whyCN: 不同的付费方适用不同费率，因此短语同时带上学生身份与金额。

senses.title: The charge at a private school
senses.titleCN: 私立学校的学费
senses.definition: the sum charged by a fee-paying rather than a state-funded school
senses.definitionCN: 由自费学校而非公立学校收取的费用
senses.example: The boarding tuition fee covers meals and lodging.
senses.exampleCN: 寄宿学费包含餐食与住宿。
senses.why: the funding source changes the bill, so a fee-paying school needs its own label for the same charge.
senses.whyCN: 经费来源改变账单，因此自费学校对同一笔收费需要自己的说法。

senses.title: An add-on charge
senses.titleCN: 学费附加费（实验、材料等）
senses.definition: an extra charge added to the basic fee for materials or facilities
senses.definitionCN: 在基本学费之外为材料或设施加收的费用
senses.example: A small tuition fee covers the art supplies.
senses.exampleCN: 一笔小额学费附加费覆盖美术耗材。
senses.why: materials and facilities generate charges beyond instruction, and the phrase extends to cover them.
senses.whyCN: 材料与设施产生教学之外的收费，短语随之扩展覆盖这些项目。

senses.title: The amount left after aid
senses.titleCN: 扣除补助后的应付学费
senses.definition: the net sum a student owes after scholarships or grants are applied
senses.definitionCN: 奖学金或补助抵扣之后学生实际应付的净额
senses.example: After the grant, the tuition fee fell to a few hundred.
senses.exampleCN: 补助之后，学费降到几百。
senses.why: scholarships reduce the amount owed, so the phrase can name the net figure rather than the list price.
senses.whyCN: 奖学金减少应付额，因此短语可以指名净额，而非价目表上的数。

senses.title: The four-year total
senses.titleCN: 四年学费总额
senses.definition: the whole sum billed across a full course of study
senses.definitionCN: 整段学业期间计收的总额
senses.example: They saved for the tuition fee years before he applied.
senses.exampleCN: 在他申请之前很多年，他们就为这笔学费存钱。
senses.why: the same annual charge multiplied across the years becomes a single figure families plan around.
senses.whyCN: 同一笔年度收费乘以年数，变成家庭据以规划的一个数字。

senses.title: The economic price of an education
senses.titleCN: 比喻：受教育的经济代价
senses.definition: the total economic cost of gaining an education, including what is given up
senses.definitionCN: 获得教育所付出的经济总代价，包括放弃的收入
senses.example: The tuition fee of that year abroad was paid in missed promotions.
senses.exampleCN: 那一年海外求学的学费，是用错过的晋升换来的。
senses.why: the money image is borrowed, so what is paid can be income given up rather than cash.
senses.whyCN: 货币意象被借用，因此付出的可以是放弃的收入，而不只是现金。

intro.en: Tuition fee pairs a Latin word for guardianship turned instruction with an Old English word for payment.
intro.cn: 这个短语把由「监护」转为「教导」的拉丁词，与一个表示付款的英语本族词配在一起。

items.en: Tueri 'to guard' gave tuitio, a watching over, which English took as tuition.
items.cn: tueri「守护」派生出 tuitio「看护」，英语把它借作 tuition。

items.en: English tuition first meant guardianship, then instruction, and in American usage the price of instruction.
items.cn: 英语 tuition 先指监护，再指教导，在美式用法里又指教导的价钱。

items.en: Feoh meant cattle, then money and property, since livestock was the earliest measure of wealth.
items.cn: feoh 原指牛群，后指钱财与财产，因为牲畜是最早的财富尺度。

items.en: Fee narrowed from property in general to a payment for a right, an office or a service.
items.cn: fee 从泛指财产收窄为为权利、职位或服务支付的款项。

items.en: Billing practice joined the two so that the service and the charge were named in one phrase.
items.cn: 计费实务把两者连起来，使服务与收费在一个短语里同时说清。

items.en: Dating note: the compound's first billing use is approximate, and the exact period when it replaced the bare word in American catalogues is not recorded.
items.cn: 年代说明：该短语最早用于计费的年代只是约数；它在美国院校收费表中取代单用词的确切时期没有记录。

note.en: Group one holds the two parts of the phrase and their close forms; group two holds other money words for study.
note.cn: 第一组是短语的两个组成部分及其近形；第二组是其他表示求学花费的词。

entries.definition: Without the second word it can mean teaching or the charge; the phrase removes that ambiguity.
entries.definitionCN: 不带后一个词时，它可指教学也可指收费；短语消除了这层歧义。

entries.definition: A charge for a service; it is the countable payment, not the whole cost of study.
entries.definitionCN: 为服务收取的费用；是可数的一笔付款，不是求学总成本。

entries.definition: The plural usually covers several charges at once, of which tuition is only one.
entries.definitionCN: 复数常指同时收取的多项费用，学费只是其中一项。

entries.definition: An adjective for a school or pupil that pays rather than being state-funded.
entries.definitionCN: 形容自费而非公立的学校或学生。

entries.definition: The whole cost of instruction, often including housing and books in journalism.
entries.definitionCN: 教学的总开支，新闻写作中常含住宿与书本。

entries.definition: The sum a provider demands for a service; broader than a school fee.
entries.definitionCN: 服务提供方要求的金额；比学校费用更宽。

entries.definition: A charge imposed by an authority; it suggests obligation rather than a price list.
entries.definitionCN: 由权威机构征收的费用；暗示义务而非价目表。

entries.definition: Awarded money that reduces what must be paid; it is the opposite direction of the same flow.
entries.definitionCN: 颁发的资助，用来减少应付金额；是同一资金流中的反向项。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real billing words, real catalogue phrases and real kitchen tables.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实计费词汇、真实收费表说法与真实的餐桌场景。

normal.en: One part names the teaching, the other names the payment: the phrase is simply the two halves pushed together.
normal.cn: 一半指教学，一半指付款：短语就是把两半推到一起。

normal.en: Without the second half the first word can mean either teaching or its price.
normal.cn: 没有后一半时，前一个词既可指教学，也可指价钱。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: pay the tuition fee, tuition fee waiver, annual tuition fee.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：缴学费、学费减免、年度学费。

normal.en: The payment word came from cattle, the oldest form of wealth.
normal.cn: 表示付款的那个词来自牛群，即最古老的财富形式。

normal.en: Bills arrive by term or by year, which is why the phrase is countable.
normal.cn: 账单按学期或按年到来，因此这个短语可数。

abstract.en: Picture a receipt folded into a school brochure.
abstract.cn: 想象一张收据被折进学校宣传册里。

abstract.en: Picture a gate with a turnstile priced per term rather than per visit.
abstract.cn: 想象一道闸机按学期而非按次收费。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger line that names both the lesson and the loss.
abstract.cn: 想象账本上的一行，同时写着课程与损失。

examples.en: The tuition fee for the program includes laboratory costs.
examples.cn: 该项目的学费包含实验室费用。

examples.en: Overseas students pay a tuition fee nearly twice the local rate.
examples.cn: 国际学生缴的学费接近本地标准的两倍。

examples.en: After the grant, the tuition fee fell to a few hundred dollars.
examples.cn: 补助之后，学费降到了几百美元。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「教学」加「付款」：为教学付的那笔钱 → 学费

root: 短语由 tuition 与 fee 合成；tuition 出自拉丁 tuitio「看护」，后引申为教导及其价款；fee 源自古英语 feoh「牛群、钱财」，后收窄为为权利或服务支付的款项。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses take one bill and change its size and scope: a year, a course, an overseas rate, a private school, an add-on, a net figure, a four-year total, and finally the whole economic price of learning.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一张账单在改变大小与范围：一学年、一门课、海外费率、私立学校、附加费、净额、四年总额，最后是求学的整体经济代价。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bill on a kitchen table with a calculator beside it and a payment plan underneath.
core.cn: 核心意象：餐桌上的一张账单，旁边放着计算器，下面压着分期说明。

branches.en: THE CORE AND THE TOTAL: one year's charge, then the same charge summed across four years.
branches.cn: 核心与总额：先是一学年的收费，再把同学年的收费累成四年。

branches.en: UNIT AND EXTRAS: a single course billed apart, and charges added for materials.
branches.cn: 单元与附加：单门课单独计费，以及为材料加收的费用。

branches.en: DIFFERENT PAYERS: the overseas rate and the private-school rate.
branches.cn: 不同的付费方：海外费率与私立学校费率。

branches.en: AFTER AID: the net figure once scholarships are applied.
branches.cn: 补助之后：奖学金抵扣后的净额。

branches.en: BORROWED PRICE: the whole cost of learning, paid partly in opportunities missed.
branches.cn: 借用的价钱：求学的整体代价，部分以错失的机会支付。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin-derived word for teaching to a native English word for payment; each half still builds its own family.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁来源的「教学」词与英语本族的「付款」词连接起来，两半各自仍能构成词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin tueri 'to guard' gives tuition, tutor and tutelage; Old English feoh 'cattle, money' gives fee and feudal.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tueri「守护」衍生出 tuition、tutor 与 tutelage；古英语 feoh「牛群、钱财」衍生出 fee 与 feudal。

items.meaning: teaching, or the charge for it
items.meaningCN: 教学，或为教学支付的费用
items.example: Tuition rose with the new laboratory.
items.exampleCN: 随着新实验室建成，学费上涨。

items.structure: fee (noun, from Old English feoh 'cattle, money')
items.meaning: a payment for a right or service
items.meaningCN: 为权利或服务支付的款项
items.example: The fee covers the examination.
items.exampleCN: 这笔费用覆盖考试。

items.example: The tuition fee is due in two parts.
items.exampleCN: 学费分两期缴纳。

items.meaning: the act or result of doing
items.example: The ending makes a noun of the guarding verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把守护的动词变成名词。

items.meaning: one who teaches a small group
items.example: Her tutor corrected the essay.
items.exampleCN: 她的导师修改了这篇文章。

items.example: Tutorials are held on Fridays.
items.exampleCN: 辅导课在周五进行。

items.example: A fee-paying school charged more.
items.exampleCN: 一所自费学校收费更高。

items.example: Fees include tuition and lodging.
items.exampleCN: 费用包括学费与住宿。

latinEntries.structure: feudal (adjective, from feoh via Medieval Latin feodum)
latinEntries.meaning: holding land in return for service

definition_zh: 大学；综合性大学；大学的全体师生或校方
definition_en: an institution of higher education that awards degrees across many fields and normally includes research and professional schools
core_image: 山丘上一组连成一片的石砌楼群，穿学位袍的人从不同的门走进同一片草坪
scene: 山丘上的老校园里，几排石砌的楼围着同一片草坪，穿学位袍的人从不同门走进同一座大厅，钟楼在中间敲响。The university admitted its first medical students more than a century ago.
sceneCN: 这里指「大学」这一机构（第 1 个义项：能授予多种学科高级学位的综合性高等教育机构）；句意为这所大学在一百多年前招收了第一批医科学生。图中可辨识物件：石砌楼群、草坪、学位袍、钟楼。

pos.zh: 大学；综合性大学
大学的全体师生或校方（集合用法）

senses.title: A degree-awarding institution
senses.titleCN: 授予学位的综合性大学
senses.definition: an institution of higher education with several faculties that awards bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees
senses.definitionCN: 设有多个学院、可授予学士、硕士与博士学位的高等教育机构
senses.example: The university admitted its first medical students more than a century ago.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学在一百多年前招收了第一批医科学生。
senses.why: the medieval name for a corporation of teachers and students became the name of the institution itself.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪对师生团体的称呼，后来成为机构本身的名称。

senses.title: The whole body of teachers and students
senses.titleCN: 全体师生；学术共同体（集合用法）
senses.definition: the assembled teachers, students and researchers of such an institution
senses.definitionCN: 这样一所机构里教师、学生与研究者的整体
senses.example: The university turned out in robes for the ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 全体师生身着学位袍出席典礼。
senses.why: the name of the corporation was heard as the people inside it, so the collective body itself took the name.
senses.whyCN: 法团的名称被听成其中的人，于是集合体本身就用上了这个名称。

senses.title: The administration
senses.titleCN: 校方；大学管理层（机构主体）
senses.definition: the governing body that decides policy and speaks for the institution
senses.definitionCN: 决定政策、代表机构的治理主体
senses.example: The university announced a new fee structure.
senses.exampleCN: 校方公布了新的收费结构。
senses.why: a corporation acts as one person in law, so the collective name came to mean the decision-making body.
senses.whyCN: 法团在法律上作为一个人行动，因此集合名称也指做决定的那一方。

senses.title: The buildings and grounds
senses.titleCN: 校园与校舍（物理场所）
senses.definition: the physical site, buildings and grounds of the institution
senses.definitionCN: 该机构的实体场地、建筑与园地
senses.example: The university sprawls along both banks of the river.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学的校园沿河两岸铺展开来。
senses.why: the possessions of the corporation, its site included, were spoken of by the same name as the body holding them.
senses.whyCN: 法团的产业连同场地，也被用持有它的那个名称来称呼。

senses.title: A particular institution
senses.titleCN: 某一所具体大学（专名语境）
senses.definition: one named institution, as distinct from higher education in general
senses.definitionCN: 指称具体某所院校，以区别于泛指的高等教育
senses.example: She chose the university closest to her family.
senses.exampleCN: 她选择了离家人最近的那所大学。
senses.why: the common noun doubles as a proper noun once the context supplies a name.
senses.whyCN: 一旦语境给出名字，普通名词就兼作专名。

senses.title: The experience of university
senses.titleCN: 大学教育经历（抽象）
senses.definition: the period or experience of studying at such an institution
senses.definitionCN: 在此类机构读书的那段时期或经历
senses.example: University taught him how to argue from evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 大学教会他如何依据证据论证。
senses.why: attending the institution is named by the institution itself, as if the place stood for the years spent in it.
senses.whyCN: 就读这一机构的行为直接用机构名来称说，仿佛地点代表了在其中度过的岁月。

senses.title: The academic world
senses.titleCN: 大学里的学术生活；学术圈
senses.definition: the world of scholarship, research and teaching that the institution supports
senses.definitionCN: 该机构所支撑的学问、研究与教学的世界
senses.example: The discovery was first discussed inside the university.
senses.exampleCN: 这一发现最先在学术圈内被讨论。
senses.why: the institution became a metonym for the scholarship carried on inside it.
senses.whyCN: 机构名称转而指代在其内部进行的学术活动。

senses.title: A meeting place of many fields
senses.titleCN: 比喻：汇聚多学科的场所
senses.definition: any place where many branches of knowledge are brought together
senses.definitionCN: 任何把许多知识门类聚到一起的场所
senses.example: The archive is a university of the city's paper records.
senses.exampleCN: 这座档案馆堪称该城纸质记录的总汇。
senses.why: the image of many faculties under one roof is borrowed for any broad gathering of knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 「诸学院同处一屋檐下」的意象被借用，指任何汇合知识的场所。

intro.en: University comes from Latin universitas, 'the whole, a corporation', built on universus 'turned into one'.
intro.cn: university 出自拉丁 universitas「整体、法团」，其词干 universus 意为「合而为一」。

items.en: Unus meant 'one', the source of unity and union as well as the first syllable here.
items.cn: 拉丁 unus 意为「一」，既是 unity、union 的来源，也是本词第一个音节的来源。

items.en: Vertere meant 'to turn', and its participle versus supplied the second half of universus.
items.cn: 拉丁 vertere 意为「转动」，其分词 versus 提供 universus 的后半部分。

items.en: Universus described things turned into a single whole, hence all together or entire.
items.cn: universus 指被转合成一个整体的，因此意为「全部、整个」。

items.en: Universitas named a totality and, in medieval law, any corporate body such as a guild or a town.
items.cn: universitas 指整体，在中世纪法律里指行会、城镇等任何法团。

items.en: A universitas magistrorum et scholarium was the corporation of masters and scholars, and the phrase shortened to university.
items.cn: 「教师与学生的团体」这一说法后来缩略成 university，专指这类法团。

items.en: Dating note: the date when the shortened form became usual is approximate; the link to the cosmic sense of universe is generally seen as later and parallel rather than the source.
items.cn: 年代说明：缩略形式通行起来的年代只是约数；与「宇宙」一义的关系一般认为属后来的并行发展，而非本义来源。

note.en: Group one holds words built on turning many things into one; group two holds other names for higher education.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「合而为一」意象的词；第二组是其他指高等教育的名称。

entries.definition: An adjective for what holds everywhere or for all; it keeps the 'one whole' idea without the institution.
entries.definitionCN: 形容放之四海或适用于全体的；保留「整体」观念，但无机构义。

entries.definition: The whole of space and matter; the same root, turned toward the cosmos instead of a school.
entries.definitionCN: 空间与物质的全体；同一词根，只是转向宇宙而非学校。

entries.definition: A prefix meaning 'apart' plus the turning root: variety rather than unity.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「分开」的前缀加「转动」词根：是多样而非统一。

entries.definition: A different root, but a neighbouring institution; in American usage a college may be smaller or independent.
entries.definitionCN: 词根不同，但属邻近机构；在美式用法里学院可能更小或独立。

entries.definition: Either a division within a university or a separate undergraduate institution.
entries.definitionCN: 既指大学内的学院，也指独立的本科院校。

entries.definition: An organisation for research or technical training, often narrower than a university.
entries.definitionCN: 从事研究或技术培训的机构，通常比大学窄。

entries.definition: A society of scholars or a specialised school; it carries the memory of Plato's grove.
entries.definitionCN: 学者团体或专门学校；带着柏拉图学园的记忆。

entries.definition: Any place of teaching, from infant classes to a university faculty; it is the broadest of the four.
entries.definitionCN: 任何教学场所，从幼儿班到大学学院；四者中范围最宽。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real roots, real institutional phrases and real campuses.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实词根、真实机构搭配与真实校园场景。

normal.en: One plus turned: many separate schools turned into a single whole.
normal.cn: 「一」加「转」：许多分开的学院被转合成一个整体。

normal.en: Medieval law called any guild a corporation; the guild of teachers took the same name.
normal.cn: 中世纪法律把任何行会都称作法团；教师的行会沿用了同一称呼。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: research university, university press, university admissions.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：研究型大学、大学出版社、大学招生。

normal.en: The cosmic word for everything shares the root but points at the sky, not at a campus.
normal.cn: 指宇宙的那个词共享词根，却指向天空，而非校园。

normal.en: The same root with a prefix meaning 'apart' gives diversity.
normal.cn: 同一词根配上表示「分开」的前缀，就得到「多样性」。

abstract.en: Picture many roads entering one walled garden from different gates.
abstract.cn: 想象许多条路从不同的门进入同一座围起的园子。

abstract.en: Picture a single roof covering a whole village of workshops.
abstract.cn: 想象一个屋顶盖住整整一个作坊村落。

abstract.en: Picture a rope braided from many strands so it holds as one.
abstract.cn: 想象一根由多股编成的绳，合起来才结实。

examples.en: The university admitted its first medical students more than a century ago.
examples.cn: 这所大学在一百多年前招收了第一批医科学生。

examples.en: The university announced a new fee structure in the spring.
examples.cn: 校方在春季公布了新的收费结构。

examples.en: She spent four years at a research university by the river.
examples.cn: 她在一所河畔的研究型大学度过了四年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一」加「转」：把许多学院转合成一个整体 → 大学

root: 拉丁 universitas「整体、法团」，由 universus「合而为一」派生，而 universus 又由 unus「一」加 vertere「转动」的分词构成。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses take one corporation and view it as an institution, a body of people, an administration, a place, a name, an experience, a scholarly world and finally any gathering of many fields.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一个法团被分别看成机构、人群、管理层、场所、专名、经历、学术世界，最后是任何汇聚多学科的地方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one walled garden with many gates, each gate belonging to a different school.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座围起的园子有许多门，每扇门属于不同的学院。

branches.en: INSTITUTION AND NAME: the degree-granting body, then one such body named in context.
branches.cn: 机构与专名：先是授予学位的机构，再是语境中具体点名的那一所。

branches.en: PEOPLE AND GOVERNANCE: the whole body, then the smaller group that decides for it.
branches.cn: 人群与治理：先是全体，再是替它做决定的较小群体。

branches.en: PLACE AND EXPERIENCE: the grounds, then the years spent inside them.
branches.cn: 场所与经历：先是园地与楼群，再是在其中度过的岁月。

branches.en: THE SCHOLARLY WORLD: what the institution supports rather than what it owns.
branches.cn: 学术世界：机构所支撑的东西，而非它拥有的东西。

branches.en: BORROWED ROOF: any place where many branches of knowledge meet.
branches.cn: 借用的屋顶：任何让许多知识门类碰面的地方。

intro.en: University is a Latin noun built from 'one' and 'turn', and the same pieces build universe, universal and diversity.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁名词，由「一」与「转」构成；同样的部件还构成 universe、universal 与 diversity。

latinIntro.en: Latin unus 'one' and vertere 'to turn' give universus, universitas, universe and universal; dis- plus vertere gives diversity.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 unus「一」与 vertere「转」构成 universus、universitas、universe 与 universal；dis- 加 vertere 则得 diversity。

items.example: The prefix supplies the unity in the name.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀提供名称里的「统一」。

items.example: The root supplies the turning that makes many into one.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「把多转成一」的转动。

items.example: The whole is described as turned into one.
items.exampleCN: 整体被描述为「转合为一」。

items.example: Medieval law used it for any guild.
items.exampleCN: 中世纪法律用它指任何行会。

items.meaning: a corporation of teachers and students
items.example: The university grew from that corporation.
items.exampleCN: 大学就是从那个法团成长起来的。

items.structure: unus + versus, used of the cosmos
items.example: The universe expanded in the model.
items.exampleCN: 模型中宇宙在膨胀。

items.example: The claim was called universal.
items.exampleCN: 这一主张被称作普遍有效的。

items.meaningCN: 由「转向不同方向」产生的多样
items.example: Diversity grew as the city changed.
items.exampleCN: 随着城市变化，多样性增加。

definition_zh: 学院；（美式）本科院校；专科学校；（英式）公学；同行团体
definition_en: a division of a university, a separate institution of higher or secondary education, or a body of people with a shared office
core_image: 同一座围院里的几栋楼，每栋门口挂着一块不同的院名牌，学生在一栋与另一栋之间换课
scene: 同一座围院里的几栋老楼，每栋门口挂着一块不同的院名牌，学生抱着书从一栋走到另一栋去换课，草坪上有人在发课程表。The college moved its library into a former chapel.
sceneCN: 这里指「学院」（第 1 个义项：大学内部按学科划分的教学单位）；句意为这所学院把图书馆搬进了一座旧礼拜堂。图中可辨识物件：院名牌、几栋老楼、抱着书的学生、旧礼拜堂。

pos.zh: 学院（大学内部的学部）
（美式）独立的本科院校或社区学院
（英式）公学；某些中学
同行团体；选举团（历史用法）

senses.title: A division of a university
senses.titleCN: 大学内部的学院
senses.definition: a teaching and research unit within a university, usually grouped by subject
senses.definitionCN: 大学内部按学科划分的教学与研究单位
senses.example: The college moved its library into a former chapel.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学院把图书馆搬进了一座旧礼拜堂。
senses.why: the oldest sense is a body of colleagues, and a faculty group is exactly such a body.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是「同僚团体」，而一群教师正是这样的团体。

senses.title: An independent undergraduate institution
senses.titleCN: 独立的本科院校（美式）
senses.definition: a separate institution offering undergraduate degrees, often smaller than a university
senses.definitionCN: 单独设立、授予本科学位的院校，通常比大学小
senses.example: She chose a small college in the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 她选择了山间的一所小型学院。
senses.why: American usage widened the word from a faculty body to the whole institution those teachers form.
senses.whyCN: 美式用法把这个词从「教师团体」扩展到这些教师构成的整个机构。

senses.title: A two-year or vocational institution
senses.titleCN: 两年制或职业院校；社区学院
senses.definition: an institution offering shorter, technical or transfer programs
senses.definitionCN: 提供较短学制、技术或转学项目的院校
senses.example: The community college runs evening welding classes.
senses.exampleCN: 社区学院开设晚间焊接课程。
senses.why: American usage extended the word from a full university to shorter institutions that still grant degrees or credits.
senses.whyCN: 美式用法把该词从完整大学扩展到仍可授学位或学分的较短学制机构。

senses.title: A fee-paying secondary school
senses.titleCN: 公学；某些中学（英式）
senses.definition: a private secondary school, as in the older English public schools
senses.definitionCN: 私立中学，如英国传统的公学
senses.example: He boarded at a college near the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 他在海边的一所公学寄宿。
senses.why: English public schools were governed as collegiate bodies, and the older name for such a foundation survived in school names.
senses.whyCN: 英国公学以团体方式治理，这类老式建制的旧称留在了校名里。

senses.title: An electoral or professional body
senses.titleCN: 选举团；专业公会（历史用法）
senses.definition: a body of people chosen to act together, as electors or as members of a profession
senses.definitionCN: 被选出共同行动的一群人，如选举人或某行业成员
senses.example: The electoral college meets after the vote.
senses.exampleCN: 选举人团在投票之后集会。
senses.why: the Latin word named any body of persons joined in one office, a sense kept in electoral and professional colleges.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语里这个词指同任一职的一群人，这层意思保留在选举团与专业公会中。

senses.title: The people of a college
senses.titleCN: 学院的师生群体（集合）
senses.definition: the assembled students, teachers and staff of such an institution
senses.definitionCN: 该院校的学生、教师与职员整体
senses.example: The whole college gathered on the lawn.
senses.exampleCN: 全院师生聚在草坪上。
senses.why: once the word meant the corporate body, it naturally stood for the people making that body up.
senses.whyCN: 该词一旦指团体，就自然用来指组成团体的那些人。

senses.title: The buildings of a college
senses.titleCN: 学院建筑与校园
senses.definition: the physical site and buildings belonging to a college
senses.definitionCN: 属于某所学院的场地与建筑
senses.example: The college is built around two courtyards.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学院围绕两个庭院建成。
senses.why: the buildings belonged to the corporate body, so the place was called by the body's name.
senses.whyCN: 建筑属于该团体，于是场所也用团体的名称来称呼。

senses.title: A group of like-minded people
senses.titleCN: 比喻：志同道合者组成的团体
senses.definition: any group bound together by a shared purpose or profession
senses.definitionCN: 任何因共同目的或职业而联结的群体
senses.example: A college of translators met to fix the terms.
senses.exampleCN: 一群译者聚在一起确定术语。
senses.why: any group sharing an office or purpose could be called a college, and the habit outlived the medieval guilds.
senses.whyCN: 任何共任一职或共有目标的群体都可称为团体，这一习惯延续到中世纪行会之后。

intro.en: College comes from Latin collegium 'society, guild', built on collega 'one chosen together with another'.
intro.cn: college 出自拉丁 collegium「团体、行会」，其词干 collega 指「与他人一同被选中的人」。

items.en: Legare meant 'to send, depute, appoint', the verb behind legate and legacy as well.
items.cn: legare 意为「派遣、委任」，也是 legate 与 legacy 的词源。

items.en: Com- 'together' plus legare produced collega, a partner in an office or duty.
items.cn: 表示「共同」的前缀加 legare 构成 collega，指同一职位或职责中的伙伴。

items.en: Collegium named the body formed by such partners, hence a guild, a board or a priestly corporation.
items.cn: collegium 指由这些伙伴形成的团体，因此指行会、委员会或祭司团。

items.en: English took college for a body of clergy or scholars sharing a house and a rule.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词，指共住一院、共守一规的教士或学者团体。

items.en: As universities grew, the word settled on the subject-based divisions inside them.
items.cn: 随着大学扩张，这个词固定指大学内部按学科划分的单位。

items.en: Dating note: the date when the word shifted from a residential society to a teaching division is approximate, and American widening to a whole institution is generally accepted but imprecisely dated.
items.cn: 年代说明：从「共住的团体」转为「教学单位」的年代只是约数；美式扩展到整个院校一般认为是自然引申，但年代不精确。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same 'chosen together' root; group two holds other names for institutions.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「一同被选中」词根的词；第二组是其他机构名称。

entries.definition: One chosen together with another, hence a fellow worker; the word names a person, not a body.
entries.definitionCN: 与他人一同被选中的人，因此指同事；指人，不指团体。

entries.definition: An adjective for the cooperative manner of colleagues; it describes style, not structure.
entries.definitionCN: 形容同僚合作方式的形容词；描述风格，不描述结构。

entries.definition: An adjective tying something to a college, as in collegiate sports.
entries.definitionCN: 把某事物与学院联系起来的形容词，如学院体育。

entries.definition: From a verb meaning 'gather together', a near neighbour in sound but not in root.
entries.definitionCN: 出自表示「收集」的动词，读音相近但词根不同。

entries.definition: An institution with several faculties and research schools; a college may be part of one.
entries.definitionCN: 设有多个学院与研究机构的高校；学院可以是它的一部分。

entries.definition: A body organised around one field or one purpose, often technical.
entries.definitionCN: 围绕一个领域或一个目的组织的机构，常为技术性。

entries.definition: A society of scholars or a school for a special skill.
entries.definitionCN: 学者团体或专门技能学校。

entries.definition: Any place or body of teaching, including a division within a university.
entries.definitionCN: 任何教学场所或团体，也包括大学内部的学部。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real roots, real campus phrases and real notice boards.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实词根、真实校园说法与真实院名牌。

normal.en: Chosen together: a body of colleagues, then the house they share, then the school inside it.
normal.cn: 「一同被选中」：先是同僚团体，再是他们共住的院子，再是院中的学校。

normal.en: The same root gives colleague, collegial and collegiate.
normal.cn: 同一词根构成同事、同僚式的与学院的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: community college, college student, electoral college.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：社区学院、大学生、选举人团。

normal.en: American usage lets college stand for a whole undergraduate institution.
normal.cn: 美式用法让这个词指整个本科院校。

normal.en: British usage keeps it for a private secondary school in the older sense.
normal.cn: 英式用法保留它指私立中学的旧义。

abstract.en: Picture a house where every door plate carries a different subject.
abstract.cn: 想象一座房子，每块门牌写着不同的学科。

abstract.en: Picture a guild hall that slowly fills with desks and blackboards.
abstract.cn: 想象一座行会大厅慢慢被课桌与黑板填满。

abstract.en: Picture a team chosen together, each carrying one page of the same rulebook.
abstract.cn: 想象一支一同被选出的队伍，每人拿着同一本规章的一页。

examples.en: The college moved its library into a former chapel.
examples.cn: 这所学院把图书馆搬进了一座旧礼拜堂。

examples.en: She chose a small college in the hills over the large university.
examples.cn: 她选择了山间的一所小型学院，而不是那所大型大学。

examples.en: The electoral college meets after the popular vote.
examples.cn: 选举人团在普选之后集会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一同被选中的人」聚在一栋楼里 → 学院

root: 拉丁 collegium「团体、行会」，由 collega「同僚」派生，而 collega 由 com-「共同」加 legare「委任、派遣」构成。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses move from a body of colleagues to the subject division, the whole institution, the shorter school, the secondary school, the electoral body, the people, the buildings and finally any like-minded group.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从「同僚团体」走到学科单位、整个院校、短期院校、中学、选举团、师生群体、建筑，最后是任何志同道合的群体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shared house whose door plates name different subjects.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座共住的院子，各扇门牌写着不同学科。

branches.en: DIVISION AND INSTITUTION: the part inside a university, then a whole school standing alone.
branches.cn: 单位与机构：先是大学内部的一部分，再是独立存在的整所学校。

branches.en: TWO KINDS OF SCHOOL: the short vocational college and the fee-paying secondary school.
branches.cn: 两类学校：短期职业院校与自费中学。

branches.en: CHOSEN BODY: electors or professionals acting together.
branches.cn: 被选出的团体：选举人或专业人士共同行动。

branches.en: PEOPLE AND PLACE: the whole college gathered, then the courtyards it gathers in.
branches.cn: 人与场所：先是聚起来的全院，再是他们聚在其中的庭院。

branches.en: BORROWED FELLOWSHIP: any group bound by one purpose.
branches.cn: 借用的同侪关系：任何因同一目的而联结的群体。

intro.en: College is a Latin body-word built from 'together' and 'appoint', and the same pieces build colleague and collegiate.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁团体名词，由「共同」与「委任」构成；同样的部件还构成 colleague 与 collegiate。

latinIntro.en: Latin legare 'to depute' gives college, colleague, legacy and legate; com- adds 'together'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 legare「委任」衍生出 college、colleague、legacy 与 legate；com- 补出「共同」。

items.example: The prefix makes the appointment a shared one.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把委任变成共同的事。

items.example: The root supplies the act of choosing someone for a duty.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「为某项职责选人」的动作。

items.example: The ending turns the partners into a body.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把伙伴变成一个团体。

items.example: Each collega held half the duty.
items.exampleCN: 每位同僚承担一半职责。

items.meaningCN: 由这些伙伴形成的团体
items.example: The collegium met in its own hall.
items.exampleCN: 该团体在自己的会堂里集会。

items.example: The college grew out of a clerical society.
items.exampleCN: 这所学院由一个教士团体发展而来。

items.example: A colleague covered the class.
items.exampleCN: 一位同事代上了这节课。

items.example: Collegiate sports are played on campus.
items.exampleCN: 学院体育在校园里进行。

definition_zh: 全体教职人员；（大学的）院、系；才能；官能；特权
definition_en: the teaching staff of a university or college, a division of such an institution, or a natural power of body or mind
core_image: 一间会议室里坐满教师，桌上摊着课程表；窗外另一栋楼挂着同一个学科的名义
scene: 会议室里坐满教师，桌上摊着课程表与考试安排，窗外另一栋楼挂着同一个学科的名义牌，走廊上还有学生来问选课。The faculty voted to shorten the winter break.
sceneCN: 这里指「全体教职人员」（第 1 个义项：一所院校的教师群体，通常作为集合名词使用）；句意为全体教师投票决定缩短寒假。图中可辨识物件：会议室、课程表、考试安排、学科名牌。

pos.zh: 全体教职人员（美式集合用法）
（大学的）学院、学部
才能；能力；官能
特权；豁免权（法律与教会用语）

derivatives.zh: 设施；便利；才能（同源双式词）

senses.title: The teaching staff
senses.titleCN: 全体教职人员（美式集合名词）
senses.definition: all the teachers of a university, college or school considered as one group
senses.definitionCN: 把一所院校的全部教师作为一个群体来看
senses.example: The faculty voted to shorten the winter break.
senses.exampleCN: 全体教师投票决定缩短寒假。
senses.why: the Latin word for capability was applied to the people who possess a particular capability, namely teaching and research.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语中表示「能力」的词被用到具有某种能力的人身上，即从事教学与研究的人。

senses.title: A subject division
senses.titleCN: 学院；学部（大学内部单位）
senses.definition: a grouping of related departments under one academic head
senses.definitionCN: 在一位学术负责人之下、由相关各系组成的单位
senses.example: He joined the faculty of law after ten years in practice.
senses.exampleCN: 执业十年之后，他加入了法学院。
senses.why: a faculty is a body of teachers in one field, and the body's name passed to the division it staffs.
senses.whyCN: 学院原指某一领域的一群教师，群体之名又转指它所支撑的学部。

senses.title: A natural ability
senses.titleCN: 才能；能力
senses.definition: a power or aptitude for doing something, especially one seen as innate
senses.definitionCN: 做某事的力量或资质，尤指被视为天生者
senses.example: She has a faculty for calming anxious patients.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一种安抚焦虑病人的本事。
senses.why: the Latin word for ease of doing gave both the power to act and the body that holds such power.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语中表示「易于做成」的词，既指行动能力，也指拥有这种能力的团体。

senses.title: A power of body or mind
senses.titleCN: 官能；感官
senses.definition: one of the powers of perception or thought, such as sight or memory
senses.definitionCN: 知觉或思维的一种能力，如视力或记忆
senses.example: The illness clouded his mental faculties.
senses.exampleCN: 疾病使他的心智官能变得模糊。
senses.why: medieval philosophy counted sight, memory and reason among the powers of the soul, and the word named each of them.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪哲学把视觉、记忆与理性算作心智的能力，该词就用来称这些能力。

senses.title: The intellect taken as a whole
senses.titleCN: 智力；心智能力（复数用法）
senses.definition: the whole set of mental powers considered together
senses.definitionCN: 把全部心智能力合起来看
senses.example: Reading in old age keeps the faculties sharp.
senses.exampleCN: 晚年阅读能让心智保持敏锐。
senses.why: when the powers were spoken of together, the plural stood for the mind taken as a whole.
senses.whyCN: 当这些能力被合起来说时，复数形式就代表整体的心智。

senses.title: A legal or ecclesiastical privilege
senses.titleCN: 特权；豁免权（法律与教会用语）
senses.definition: a special right granted by an authority to a person or a body
senses.definitionCN: 由权威授予个人或团体的特别权利
senses.example: The bishop exercised his faculty to license the chapel.
senses.exampleCN: 主教行使特权为该礼拜堂颁发许可。
senses.why: a grant from a superior let a person or body act outside the common rule, and the word named that permission.
senses.whyCN: 上级的授予让个人或团体越过通行规则行事，该词就指这种许可。

senses.title: The teaching body as distinct from administration
senses.titleCN: 师资队伍（与行政相对）
senses.definition: teachers viewed as a body separate from managers and trustees
senses.definitionCN: 被视为与管理者、校董相区别的教师群体
senses.example: Faculty and staff negotiate separately.
senses.exampleCN: 教师与职员分开谈判。
senses.why: the teachers of a university were its faculty in the old corporate sense, later set against the administration.
senses.whyCN: 大学的教师群体原是旧义上的团体，后来与行政一方相对。

senses.title: The abstract condition of being able
senses.titleCN: 抽象：做某事的内在条件或资质
senses.definition: the underlying capacity that makes an achievement possible
senses.definitionCN: 使某项成就成为可能的底层条件
senses.example: Patience is the faculty behind good editing.
senses.exampleCN: 耐心是好编辑背后的那种资质。
senses.why: the concrete power was abstracted into whatever condition makes an achievement possible.
senses.whyCN: 具体的能力被抽象为任何使成就成为可能的条件。

intro.en: Faculty comes from Latin facultas 'ease, capability, opportunity', built on facilis 'easy', which rests on facere 'to do, make'.
intro.cn: faculty 出自拉丁 facultas「容易、能力、机会」，其词干 facilis 意为「容易」，而 facilis 又出自 facere「做、造」。

items.en: Facere 'to do, make' is one of the busiest roots in Latin and stands behind fact, effect and facility.
items.cn: facere「做、造」是拉丁语中最活跃的词根之一，也是 fact、effect 与 facility 的来源。

items.en: Facilis meant 'easy to do', formed from facere with a suffix of capability.
items.cn: facilis 意为「容易做的」，由 facere 加表示能力的词尾构成。

items.en: Facultas generalized the adjective into ease, ability, opportunity and, in law, a power to act.
items.cn: facultas 把这个形容词一般化为「容易、能力、机会」，在法律里又指行动的权力。

items.en: Old French faculte carried the word into English, where it first named a power of mind or body.
items.cn: 古法语 faculte 把这个词带入英语，最初指心智或身体的一种能力。

items.en: Medieval universities grouped teachers by their area of capability, and the group took the name faculty.
items.cn: 中世纪大学按教师的能力领域分组，这个组就得了 faculty 之名。

items.en: Dating note: the exact date when faculty came to mean the teaching staff rather than a subject group is approximate; both readings developed side by side.
items.cn: 年代说明：faculty 从「学科组」转为「全体教师」的确切年代只是约数；两种读法长期并行。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same 'do, make' root; group two holds other names for staff and capability.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「做、造」词根的词；第二组是其他指师资与能力的名称。

entries.definition: The same Latin word borrowed twice: it now means ease of doing something or the equipment that provides it.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个拉丁词被借了两次：现在指做事的便利，或提供便利的设备。

entries.definition: An adjective for something done too easily, hence shallow or careless.
entries.definitionCN: 形容做得太容易，因此流于肤浅或草率。

entries.definition: A verb built on the same stem: to make a process easier.
entries.definitionCN: 同词干构成的动词：使某个过程更容易。

entries.definition: From the same root in its 'act' sense: a group acting together, often against another.
entries.definitionCN: 同一词根取「行动」义：共同行动的一群，常与他群对立。

entries.definition: Everyone employed by an institution, teachers and administrators alike; faculty covers teachers only.
entries.definitionCN: 机构雇用的所有人，包括教师与行政；该词只覆盖教师。

entries.definition: A plain phrase for the teachers of a school; faculty is its formal, often university-level counterpart.
entries.definitionCN: 对学校教师的朴素说法；该词是其正式对应，多用于高校。

entries.definition: The power to contain or perform; close to the ability sense of faculty.
entries.definitionCN: 容纳或执行的能力；接近该词的「能力」义。

entries.definition: A subject unit inside a faculty; the faculty is the grouping above it.
entries.definitionCN: 学院之下的学科单位；该词是它上面的分组。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real roots, real committee phrases and real meeting rooms.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实词根、真实委员会说法与真实会议室场景。

normal.en: The root means to do or make; the noun first meant the power to do, then the people who have it.
normal.cn: 词根意为「做、造」；名词先指做事的能力，再指拥有这种能力的人。

normal.en: The same root gives facility, facile and facilitate, all about ease.
normal.cn: 同一词根构成表示「设施」「容易」「使便利」的一组词，核心都是「容易」。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: faculty member, faculty meeting, faculty of law.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：教职人员、教师会议、法学院。

normal.en: One word covers the staff, the division and the mental power.
normal.cn: 同一个词覆盖教师群体、学院单位与心智能力。

normal.en: The plural faculties usually means the powers of the mind.
normal.cn: 复数形式通常指心智的各种能力。

abstract.en: Picture a room full of people, each holding one key that opens a different door.
abstract.cn: 想象一屋子人，每人拿着一把钥匙，各开一扇不同的门。

abstract.en: Picture a hand with five fingers, each able to do one thing well.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手的五根手指，每根擅长一件事。

abstract.en: Picture a workshop where the tools and the workers share one name.
abstract.cn: 想象一个作坊，工具与工人都用同一个名字。

examples.en: The faculty voted to shorten the winter break.
examples.cn: 全体教师投票决定缩短寒假。

examples.en: He joined the faculty of law after ten years in practice.
examples.cn: 执业十年之后，他加入了法学院。

examples.en: The illness clouded his mental faculties for weeks.
examples.cn: 疾病使他的心智官能模糊了好几周。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「做事的能力」转到「有这种能力的人」→ 全体教师

root: 拉丁 facultas「容易、能力、机会」，由 facilis「容易的」派生，而 facilis 出自 facere「做、造」；该词根也构成 facility、facile 与 facilitate。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses begin with the people who can do a thing, then the unit they form, then the power itself, its parts, the intellect as a whole, a legal power, the staff as a negotiating body and finally any underlying capacity.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从「能做某事的人」开始，再是他们构成的单位，再是能力本身、能力的各个部分、作为整体的心智、法律上的权力、作为谈判方的师资，最后是任何底层资质。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one room of teachers, one subject plate on the door, and one hand holding five separate keys.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间坐满教师的屋子，门上挂着一块学科牌，一只手握着五把不同的钥匙。

branches.en: PEOPLE: the whole teaching body, then that body acting as a separate party.
branches.cn: 人：先是整个教师群体，再是这个群体作为独立一方行动。

branches.en: OFFICIAL BODIES: the subject division, and the legal body granted a privilege.
branches.cn: 正式单位：学科分院，以及获授特权的法定团体。

branches.en: CAPABILITY: a named ability, then the general condition that makes achievement possible.
branches.cn: 能力：先是一种具体本事，再是使成就成为可能的总体条件。

branches.en: THE SENSES: sight, hearing and memory as separate powers.
branches.cn: 官能：视、听、记忆作为各自独立的能力。

branches.en: THE INTELLECT AS A WHOLE: all the mental powers taken together.
branches.cn: 心智整体：把全部心智能力合起来看。

intro.en: Faculty is a Latin noun of capability built on the verb 'to do', and the same root yields facility, facile and facilitate.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁能力名词，建在表示「做」的动词上；同一词根还产生 facility、facile 与 facilitate。

latinIntro.en: Latin facere 'to do, make' gives fact, effect, facility, facile and faculty; -tas turns the adjective into a noun of state.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 facere「做、造」衍生出 fact、effect、facility、facile 与 faculty；-tas 把形容词变成状态名词。

items.example: The root supplies the doing behind every sense.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供每个义项背后的「做」。

items.example: The adjective narrows the root toward ease.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词把词根收窄到「容易」。

items.example: The ending turns the adjective into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把形容词变成名词。

items.example: The noun covered both capability and chance.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词同时覆盖能力与机会。

items.meaning: a power, then the people who have it
items.meaningCN: 能力；后指拥有能力的人
items.example: The faculty met on Monday.
items.exampleCN: 教师群体周一开会。

items.example: The new facility has two labs.
items.exampleCN: 新设施有两个实验室。

items.example: His facile answer satisfied nobody.
items.exampleCN: 他那轻率的回答谁也没说服。

items.example: Good notes facilitate review.
items.exampleCN: 好的笔记有助于复习。

definition_zh: 部门；（大学的）系；政府的司、局、处；职责范围
definition_en: a division of a large organisation, such as a university subject unit or a government ministry, or the area of work assigned to it
core_image: 一张总图被虚线切成若干格，每格标着一个职能名称，格与格之间只隔一条线
scene: 办公楼的走廊两侧，门牌一块接一块，每块写着不同的职能名称，访客拿着表格从一块门牌走到下一块去盖章。The history department hired two specialists in medieval trade.
sceneCN: 这里指「大学的系」（第 1 个义项：大学内按学科划分的教学单位）；句意为历史系聘请了两位研究中世纪贸易的专家。图中可辨识物件：门牌、走廊、盖章表格、职能名称。

pos.zh: 部门；处室；学部；系
职责范围；分管领域（口语）
（法国等国的）省；行政区

senses.title: A university subject unit
senses.titleCN: 大学的系；学部
senses.definition: a division of a university organised around one subject or group of subjects
senses.definitionCN: 大学里围绕一个学科或一组学科划分的单位
senses.example: The history department hired two specialists in medieval trade.
senses.exampleCN: 历史系聘请了两位研究中世纪贸易的专家。
senses.why: the root means 'to part', and a university part is exactly a slice of the whole.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为「分开」，而大学的「一部分」正是整块切下的一角。

senses.title: A government ministry division
senses.titleCN: 政府部门的司、局、处
senses.definition: a branch of government administration responsible for a policy area
senses.definitionCN: 负责某一政策领域的政府行政分支
senses.example: The department of health issued new guidance.
senses.exampleCN: 卫生部门发布了新的指引。
senses.why: French administration divided the state into departments, and the same word named a division of a ministry.
senses.whyCN: 法国行政把国家划分成省，同一个词也用来指部委内部的司局。

senses.title: A business unit
senses.titleCN: 企业内部的部门
senses.definition: a functional unit within a company, such as sales or accounts
senses.definitionCN: 公司内部按职能划分的单位，如销售部或财务部
senses.example: She moved from sales to the research department.
senses.exampleCN: 她从销售部调到了研究部。
senses.why: the idea of a bounded share of work was carried from government into the offices of commerce.
senses.whyCN: 把工作切成有边界的份额这一想法，从政府带进了商业机构。

senses.title: A section of a large shop
senses.titleCN: 百货商店的货品部
senses.definition: one of the separate selling areas of a large store
senses.definitionCN: 大型商店里各自独立的售卖区域
senses.example: The shoe department is on the second floor.
senses.exampleCN: 鞋帽部在二楼。
senses.why: retail borrowed the administrative word for its own slices of floor space.
senses.whyCN: 零售业借用了行政词汇，用来指自己划分出的卖场空间。

senses.title: One's assigned area of responsibility
senses.titleCN: 职责范围；分管领域（口语）
senses.definition: the area of work a person is responsible for, often used to decline a task
senses.definitionCN: 一个人负责的工作范围，常用于推辞某项事务
senses.example: Fixing the printer is not my department.
senses.exampleCN: 修打印机不归我管。
senses.why: if work is divided into departments, then what one is answerable for can be called one's department.
senses.whyCN: 既然工作按部门划分，一个人所负责的部分就可称作他的部门。

senses.title: A territorial division
senses.titleCN: 行政区；省（法国等国）
senses.definition: an administrative region of a country, especially in France
senses.definitionCN: 一国的行政区域，尤指法国等国的省
senses.example: The school lies in the southern department.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校位于南部省份。
senses.why: the revolutionary settlement cut the country into named territorial departments, and English borrowed the term.
senses.whyCN: 大革命时期的行政安排把国土划成有名称的省，英语借用了这一称呼。

senses.title: A newspaper or magazine section
senses.titleCN: 报刊的专版；专版编辑部
senses.definition: a themed section of a publication and the staff who produce it
senses.definitionCN: 刊物中按主题划分的版面及其编辑人员
senses.example: The features department sent a photographer.
senses.exampleCN: 专版编辑部派了一名摄影师。
senses.why: editors divided a paper the way an administration divides work, and each themed section became a department.
senses.whyCN: 编辑像行政分派工作那样把报纸分块，每个主题版面就成了一个部门。

senses.title: Any divided field of activity
senses.titleCN: 抽象：任何被划分出来的职能领域
senses.definition: a sphere of activity treated as a separate division of effort
senses.definitionCN: 被当作独立一块工作的活动领域
senses.example: Ethics is everyone's department, not one committee's.
senses.exampleCN: 伦理是每个人的分内事，而非某一个委员会的事。
senses.why: once division became the point of the word, any separated sphere of effort could carry it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦「划分」成为该词的核心，任何被分出来的事务领域都能用它。

intro.en: Department comes from French département, from départir 'to divide', built on Latin pars 'part'.
intro.cn: department 来自法语 département，其动词 départir 意为「分开」，词干出自拉丁 pars「部分」。

items.en: Pars meant 'a part, a share', the source of partition, partial and particle as well.
items.cn: pars 意为「部分、份额」，也是 partition、partial 与 particle 的来源。

items.en: Partire meant 'to divide, to share out', turning the noun of part into an act.
items.cn: partire 意为「分开、分配」，把「部分」的名词变成动作。

items.en: De- 'apart' plus partir produced départir, to separate or divide into shares.
items.cn: 表示「分开」的前缀加 partir 构成 départir，意为分开或按份划分。

items.en: Département named a division, first of territory and later of administration.
items.cn: département 指划分出来的单位，先用于领土，后用于行政。

items.en: English borrowed it in the eighteenth century for government and institutional divisions.
items.cn: 英语在十八世纪借入，用于政府与机构的划分单位。

items.en: Dating note: the eighteenth-century first record is approximate, and the order in which the university, government and retail senses appeared is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 年代说明：十八世纪的最早记录只是约数；大学、政府与零售三种义项出现的先后没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same 'part' root; group two holds other words for divisions.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「部分」词根的词；第二组是其他表示划分单位的词。

entries.definition: The verb means to go away from a place; the noun's root sense of dividing survives only in the institution.
entries.definitionCN: 动词指离开某地；名词里「划分」的词根义只保留在机构用法中。

entries.definition: The act of going away; it shares the prefix and root but has lost the dividing sense.
entries.definitionCN: 离开的动作；共享前缀与词根，但已失去「划分」义。

entries.definition: An adjective tying something to one division, as in a departmental budget.
entries.definitionCN: 把某事物与某个部门联系起来的形容词，如部门预算。

entries.definition: From the same part-root: a division, often a physical one.
entries.definitionCN: 同出「部分」词根：指划分，常指实体的隔断。

entries.definition: A broad word for any split, in organisations or in arithmetic.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指任何划分，用于组织，也用于除法。

entries.definition: A part cut off from a larger whole; smaller and less formal than a department.
entries.definitionCN: 从整体切下的一部分；比部门更小、更不正式。

entries.definition: A single organised block, often functional or military.
entries.definitionCN: 一个组织单位，常指职能或军事编制。

entries.definition: The usual British name for a top-level government department.
entries.definitionCN: 英式对政府高级部门的常用称呼。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real roots, real door plates and real organisational charts.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实词根、真实门牌与真实组织架构图。

normal.en: The root means part: a department is one slice cut from a larger body.
normal.cn: 词根意为「部分」：部门就是从更大整体上切下的一片。

normal.en: The same root gives part, partial and partition.
normal.cn: 同一词根构成表示「部分」「局部的」「分割」的一组词。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: department store, department head, history department.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：百货商店、部门主管、历史系。

normal.en: University, government and shop all use the same slice-word.
normal.cn: 大学、政府与商店都用同一个「切片」词。

normal.en: The dismissive phrase 'not my department' turns the word into a boundary.
normal.cn: 推辞用的「不归我管」把这个词变成一条边界。

abstract.en: Picture a single sheet of paper ruled into labelled boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸被画成若干标着名字的格子。

abstract.en: Picture a corridor where every door opens onto one specialised room.
abstract.cn: 想象一条走廊，每扇门都通向一个专门的房间。

abstract.en: Picture a cake cut into slices, each with its own label.
abstract.cn: 想象一只蛋糕被切成片，每片都贴着自己的标签。

examples.en: The history department hired two specialists in medieval trade.
examples.cn: 历史系聘请了两位研究中世纪贸易的专家。

examples.en: The department of health issued new guidance on the disease.
examples.cn: 卫生部门发布了关于该疾病的新指引。

examples.en: Fixing the printer is not my department.
examples.cn: 修打印机不归我管。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把整体「分开」切出的一块，每块挂一块门牌 → 部门、系

root: 法语 département「划分出的单位」，来自动词 départir「分开」，其词干出自拉丁 pars「部分」；pars 再上溯为原始印欧「切分」类词根，具体形式属重构。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses are one slice under different roofs: a university subject, a government branch, a company function, a shop floor, a personal duty, a province, a newspaper section and any divided field of effort.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一片「切片」放在不同屋檐下：大学的学科、政府分支、公司职能、卖场、个人职责、省份、报刊版面，以及任何被划分出来的工作领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one sheet of paper ruled into boxes, each box carrying a single label.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张被画成格子的纸，每格只写一个名称。

branches.en: TWO PUBLIC ROOFS: the subject unit and the government branch.
branches.cn: 两种公共屋檐：学科单位与政府分支。

branches.en: TWO COMMERCIAL ROOFS: the company function and the shop floor.
branches.cn: 两种商业屋檐：公司职能与卖场分区。

branches.en: THE PERSONAL CUT: what one is responsible for, and any field claimed as separate.
branches.cn: 个人的切片：一个人负责的范围，以及任何被划为独立的领域。

branches.en: THE MAP CUT: a province drawn as an administrative slice.
branches.cn: 地图上的切片：作为行政区划切出的省份。

branches.en: THE PAGE CUT: a themed section of a publication.
branches.cn: 纸面上的切片：刊物的主题版面。

intro.en: Department is a French word built from a Latin part-word; the same pieces build depart, departure and partition.
intro.cn: 这个词是法语词，建在拉丁「部分」词上；同样的部件还构成 depart、departure 与 partition。

latinIntro.en: Latin pars 'part' gives part, partial, particle, partition and department; de- adds 'apart'.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 pars「部分」衍生出 part、partial、particle、partition 与 department；de- 补出「分开」。

items.example: The prefix marks separation from the whole.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出与整体的分离。

items.example: The root supplies the slice itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「切下的那一片」。

items.meaning: the act or result of dividing
items.example: The ending turns the dividing verb into a noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把划分的动词变成名词。

items.example: The verb turns the part into an act.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词把「部分」变成动作。

items.example: The department meets on Fridays.
items.exampleCN: 该部门周五开会。

items.example: A departmental budget was approved.
items.exampleCN: 部门预算获得批准。

items.meaning: to go apart from a place
items.example: The train departs at six.
items.exampleCN: 列车六点出发。

items.example: A partition split the room in two.
items.exampleCN: 一道隔断把房间分成两半。

definition_zh: 学科；（大学的）学科门类；学术训练与规范
definition_en: a branch of knowledge with its own methods, standards and body of study, as established in universities
core_image: 走廊两侧每个办公室门口都挂着不同学科的名牌，学生抱着书从一扇门走向另一扇
scene: 走廊两侧每个办公室门口都挂着不同学科的名牌，学生抱着书从一扇门走向另一扇，墙上的公告列着各学科的评审规则。Every academic discipline has its own way of judging evidence.
sceneCN: 这里指「学科」（第 1 个义项：拥有自身方法、标准与研究对象的学问门类）；句意为每一门学科都有自己判断证据的方式。图中可辨识物件：学科名牌、抱着书的学生、评审规则公告、走廊。

pos.zh: 学科；学问门类（可数）
学术训练；学术规范（不可数）
学科规训（知识体系对人的塑造，抽象）

senses.title: A branch of knowledge
senses.titleCN: 学科；有系统方法的学问门类
senses.definition: a field of study with its own subject matter, methods and standards
senses.definitionCN: 拥有自身研究对象、方法与标准的学问领域
senses.example: Every academic discipline has its own way of judging evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 每一门学科都有自己判断证据的方式。
senses.why: the two words combine a school's name with the idea of training, so a discipline is a field defined by how it trains its students.
senses.whyCN: 两个词把「学校」之名与「训练」之意合起来，因此学科是按「如何训练学生」来界定的一片领域。

senses.title: A university subject unit
senses.titleCN: 大学里的系科建制
senses.definition: an institutional unit in which that field is taught and examined
senses.definitionCN: 讲授并考核该领域的建制单位
senses.example: The committee reviews each academic discipline every five years.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会每五年评审每一个学科。
senses.why: a discipline is first a field of instruction, and the unit that teaches it took the field's name.
senses.whyCN: 学科原指一门教学领域，讲授它的建制单位便沿用了这一名称。

senses.title: Scholarly training
senses.titleCN: 学术训练；学术规范
senses.definition: the training and standards that shape how work in a field is done
senses.definitionCN: 塑造某一领域工作方式的训练与标准
senses.example: The program teaches the discipline of careful citation.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目教授严谨引证这一学术规范。
senses.why: training is the older sense of the second word; a field without training is only a topic.
senses.whyCN: 「训练」是第二个词的旧义；没有训练的领域只是一个话题。

senses.title: The shaping of a learner
senses.titleCN: 学科规训（知识体系对人的塑造，抽象）
senses.definition: the way a field's rules gradually form the habits and judgement of its students
senses.definitionCN: 某一领域的规则逐步塑造学生习惯与判断力的方式
senses.example: Years of academic discipline changed how she read a page.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的学科规训改变了她读一页书的方式。
senses.why: training in a field imposes its rules on the learner, so the field's name came to mean that shaping.
senses.whyCN: 在某一领域受训就是把其规则加在学人身上，于是领域之名也指这种塑造。

senses.title: A research field within a discipline
senses.titleCN: 某一学科内的研究领域
senses.definition: a specialised area inside a larger field, with its own journals and questions
senses.definitionCN: 较大领域内更专门的分区，有自己的期刊与问题
senses.example: Medieval trade is a small discipline inside history.
senses.exampleCN: 中世纪贸易是历史学内部的一个小研究领域。
senses.why: a bounded field of study inside a larger one is treated as a discipline of its own.
senses.whyCN: 较大领域内有边界的研究范围，被当作一门独立的学科。

senses.title: A hybrid branch
senses.titleCN: 交叉学科形成的分支
senses.definition: a field formed where two or more disciplines overlap
senses.definitionCN: 由两个或更多学科交叠而成的领域
senses.example: Bioinformatics grew as a new academic discipline.
senses.exampleCN: 生物信息学作为一门新学科成长起来。
senses.why: where two fields overlap, the overlap is organised and taught as a new discipline.
senses.whyCN: 两个领域重叠之处被组织起来，并作为新的学科来教授。

senses.title: The ethical code of scholarship
senses.titleCN: 学术纪律；学术共同体的行为规范
senses.definition: the shared rules of honesty, attribution and evidence that scholars enforce
senses.definitionCN: 学者共同维护的诚实、署名与证据规则
senses.example: Plagiarism violates the discipline of the profession.
senses.exampleCN: 抄袭违反这一行业的学术纪律。
senses.why: the field's rules of proof and attribution are enforced like a discipline imposed on its members.
senses.whyCN: 该领域关于论证与归属的规则，像加在成员身上的纪律那样被执行。

senses.title: Any field requiring long training
senses.titleCN: 比喻：需要长期训练才能掌握的专门领域
senses.definition: any specialised sphere that demands years of guided practice
senses.definitionCN: 任何需要多年有人指导的练习才能掌握的专门领域
senses.example: Restoring old violins is a discipline of the hands and ears.
senses.exampleCN: 修复古提琴是一门要靠手与耳朵的专门功夫。
senses.why: any body of practice with its own method was seen as a field one must be trained into.
senses.whyCN: 任何有自身方法的实践体系，都被看成必须经过训练才能进入的领域。

intro.en: The phrase joins academic, from the name of Plato's school, to discipline, from Latin disciplina 'instruction'.
intro.cn: 这个短语把来自柏拉图学园之名的 academic 与出自拉丁 disciplina「教导」的 discipline 连在一起。

items.en: Akadēmeia was the grove outside Athens where Plato taught, named after the hero Akademos.
items.cn: Akadēmeia 是雅典城外柏拉图讲学的那片园林，得名于英雄阿卡德摩斯。

items.en: English academic first meant 'of the school of Plato', then 'of universities and scholarship'.
items.cn: 英语 academic 先指「属于柏拉图学园的」，后指「属于大学与学问的」。

items.en: Discere meant 'to learn', the verb behind disciple as well as discipline.
items.cn: discere 意为「学习」，既是 disciple 的词源，也是 discipline 的词源。

items.en: Disciplina meant instruction and the training that goes with it, and later also a branch of study.
items.cn: disciplina 指教导及随之而来的训练，后来又指一门学问分支。

items.en: English discipline kept both faces, the training and the rule, and universities applied it to fields of study.
items.cn: 英语 discipline 两面都保留：训练与规则；大学又把它用到学科领域上。

items.en: Dating note: the date when the two words became a fixed phrase is approximate, and the extension from 'training' to 'field' is generally accepted but not precisely dated.
items.cn: 年代说明：两个词凝成固定短语的年代只是约数；从「训练」扩展到「学科」一般认为是自然引申，但年代不精确。

note.en: Group one holds words built from the learning and schooling roots; group two holds other names for areas of study.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「学习」与「学园」词根的词；第二组是其他指研究领域的名称。

entries.definition: An adjective for university life and scholarship; alone it names a person who works in higher education.
entries.definitionCN: 形容大学生活与学术的；单用时指在高校工作的人。

entries.definition: A learned society or specialised school; it keeps the place-name at the centre.
entries.definitionCN: 学者团体或专门学校；以地名为核心。

entries.tag: of rules or of a field
entries.definition: An adjective with two readings, one about punishment and one about the boundaries of a field.
entries.definitionCN: 有两个读法的形容词：一关于惩戒，一关于学科边界。

entries.definition: A person who insists on rules; it has nothing to do with fields of study.
entries.definitionCN: 坚持规则的人；与学科领域无关。

entries.definition: A school or university subject; broader and looser than a discipline, which implies method.
entries.definitionCN: 学校或大学里的科目；比学科更宽、更松，学科则含方法之意。

entries.definition: A general area of research or activity; it need not have a settled method.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指研究或活动的领域；不必然有定型的方法。

entries.definition: The subject a student specialises in; it describes a course of study, not a body of knowledge.
entries.definitionCN: 学生主修的专业；指一段学习安排，而非知识体系。

entries.definition: A plain phrase for any organised subject; it carries no claim about method or standards.
entries.definitionCN: 对任何成体系科目的朴素说法；不对方法或标准作任何主张。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real roots, real campus plates and real review rules.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实词根、真实学科名牌与真实评审规则。

normal.en: A school's name plus the word for training: a field defined by how it trains its students.
normal.cn: 「学园之名」加「训练」：按如何训练学生来界定的一片领域。

normal.en: The second word also means rule, which is why the phrase can cover academic conduct.
normal.cn: 第二个词也指规则，因此这个短语也能覆盖学术行为。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: academic discipline, interdisciplinary study, core discipline.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：学科、跨学科研究、核心学科。

normal.en: The learning root also gives disciple, one who learns.
normal.cn: 表示「学习」的词根还构成表示「门徒」的词，即学习的人。

normal.en: A discipline is more than a topic: it has methods and standards.
normal.cn: 学科不只是一个话题：它有方法与标准。

abstract.en: Picture a corridor where each door plate is a different way of asking questions.
abstract.cn: 想象一条走廊，每块门牌都是一种不同的提问方式。

abstract.en: Picture a garden with many paths, each worn by generations of feet.
abstract.cn: 想象一座园子有许多条路，每条都被一代代脚步磨出痕迹。

abstract.en: Picture a hand taught to hold a tool in one exact way.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手被训练成以唯一正确的方式握工具。

examples.en: Every academic discipline has its own way of judging evidence.
examples.cn: 每一门学科都有自己判断证据的方式。

examples.en: Bioinformatics grew as a new academic discipline at the edge of biology and computing.
examples.cn: 生物信息学作为生物学与计算科学交界处的新学科成长起来。

examples.en: Years of academic discipline changed how she read a page.
examples.cn: 多年的学科规训改变了她读一页书的方式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「学园」加「训练」：靠一套训练方法立起来的学问 → 学科

root: 短语由 academic 与 discipline 合成；academic 出自希腊 Akadēmeia「柏拉图讲学的园林」，discipline 出自拉丁 disciplina「教导」，其动词 discere 意为「学习」。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses start from a field with methods, then its institutional unit, its training, its shaping of a learner, its specialised corners, its hybrid branches, its ethical rules and finally any field that demands long practice.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从「有方法的学问领域」开始，再是其建制单位、训练、对学习者的塑造、专门分区、交叉分支、伦理规则，最后是任何需要长期练习的领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a corridor of door plates, each standing for one way of asking questions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条走廊上的一排门牌，每块代表一种提问方式。

branches.en: THE FIELD AND ITS CORNERS: the whole discipline, then a specialised area inside it.
branches.cn: 领域与其角落：先是整门学科，再是它内部的一个专门分区。

branches.en: FORMS IN INSTITUTIONS: the standing unit, and the hybrid branch formed at the edges.
branches.cn: 建制中的形态：常设单位，以及边界处长出的交叉分支。

branches.en: TRAINING AND ITS EFFECT: the standards taught, then the habits they leave in a learner.
branches.cn: 训练与其效果：先是所教的标准，再是它们在学习者身上留下的习惯。

branches.en: THE RULE SIDE: honesty and attribution enforced by the field itself.
branches.cn: 规则一侧：由领域自身维护的诚实与署名规则。

branches.en: BORROWED CRAFT: any sphere that demands years of guided practice.
branches.cn: 借用的技艺：任何需要多年有人指导的练习的领域。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Greek place-name turned adjective to a Latin word for instruction; both halves still build their own families.
intro.cn: 这个短语把由希腊地名转成的形容词与拉丁「教导」一词连起来，两半各自仍构成词族。

latinIntro.en: Greek Akadēmeia gives academic and academy; Latin discere 'to learn' gives discipline, disciple and disciplinary.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 Akadēmeia 衍生出 academic 与 academy；拉丁 discere「学习」衍生出 discipline、disciple 与 disciplinary。

items.meaningCN: 柏拉图讲学的那片园林
items.example: The name of the grove became the name of schooling.
items.exampleCN: 园林之名后来成了学校之名。

items.meaning: of the school or of scholarship
items.example: The academic year begins in autumn.
items.exampleCN: 学年在秋天开始。

items.example: The academy elected three new members.
items.exampleCN: 该学会选出了三位新成员。

items.example: The root supplies the learning behind the training.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供训练背后的「学习」。

items.example: The discipulus followed the master for years.
items.exampleCN: 学生跟随老师多年。

items.example: Disciplina covered both lesson and order.
items.exampleCN: 这个词同时覆盖课业与秩序。

items.meaning: training, rule, and later a field
items.example: The discipline has its own journals.
items.exampleCN: 这门学科有自己的期刊。

items.example: An interdisciplinary team wrote the report.
items.exampleCN: 一个跨学科团队撰写了这份报告。
